basic_details.job_title: CES Project Associate II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Centre for Environmental Studies (CES), Anna University, Chennai is engaging two Project Associate - II staff, one each for two consultancy projects on biomining of legacy waste, on a purely temporary basis at a consolidated salary of Rs.30,000/- per month for six months, extendable based on performance up to the project period. Candidates need a B.E or B.Tech. in the listed branches with an M.E or M.Tech in the listed specialisations. The application form, with copies of academic and experience documents, must be sent by post or handed in to the Professor and Director, CES, Anna Universit

how_to_apply: Fill in the application form printed on page 2 of the notice (personal details, category, addresses, mobile number, email ID, education from 10th standard onwards and professional experience, if any) and affix a recent passport size photo.
Mention your email ID, contact number and complete postal address in the application.
Sign the declaration on the form with place and date.
Put the form in a cover along with copies of all academic qualification documents and experience documents.
Write the name of the project you are applying for on the cover.
Send the cover by post or hand it in to: Professor and Director, Centre for Environmental Studies, Anna University, Chennai 600 025.
Make sure it is submitted on or before 07.12.2026.
Filled application form with a recent passport size photo affixed
Copies of all academic qualification documents
important_instructions: Each application cover must carry the name of the project applied for, as the two posts belong to different projects. By signing the declaration, the applicant accepts that the Institute's decision on selection is final. The declaration states that the Institute may expel a selected person if the particulars furnished are found false or if the person's antecedents make continuance not desirable.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification differs slightly between the two projects. In both, the bachelor's degree must be held "with" the listed master's degree. The notice prints no experience requirement, but the application form has a "Professional Experience (if any)" section and the notice asks applicants to enclose experience documents. The age limit is not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.post: Project Associate - II (Sl. No. 1 – Ramayapatti, Tirunelveli project)
rows.essential_qualification: B.E or B.Tech. in Civil Engineering / B.E Environmental Engineering / B.E Energy & Environment / B.E Geo informatics with M.E or M.Tech in Environmental Engineering / Environmental Management / Energy & Environment / Geo informatics / Remote Sensing

rows.post: Project Associate - II (Sl. No. 2 – Kumbakonam project)
rows.essential_qualification: B.E or B.Tech. in Civil Engineering / B.E Environmental Engineering with M.E or M.Tech in Environmental Engineering / Environmental Management / Energy & Environment / Environmental Science and Technology

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Salary: Rs.30,000/- per month for each post, paid on a consolidated salary basis. Initial period: six months. Extension: extendable based on the candidate's performance, up to the project period. Nature of engagement: the post is purely on a temporary basis.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Anna University CES Project Associate - II
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form printed on page 2 of the notice (personal details, category, addresses, mobile number, email ID, education from 10th standard onwards and professional experience, if any) and affix a recent passport size photo. Mention your email ID, contact number and complete postal address in the application. Sign the declaration on the form with place and date. Put the form in a cover along with copies of all academic qualification documents and experience documents. Write the name of the project you are applying for on the cover. Send the cover by post or hand it in to: Professor and Director, Centre for Environmental Studies, Anna University, Chennai 600 025. Make sure it is submitted on or before 07.12.2026. Filled application form with a recent passport size photo affixed Copies of all academic qualification documents Copies of experience documents

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be shortlisted, and shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. Selection will be based on the interview. The interview date has not been announced in the notice, and no TA/DA will be paid for appearing for the interview.

The declaration states that the Institute may expel a selected person if the particulars furnished are found false or if the person's antecedents make continuance not desirable.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Associate - II vacancies has Anna University CES announced?
faq.answer: Two posts are announced, one for the Ramayapatti (Tirunelveli) biomining project and one for the Kumbakonam legacy waste removal project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Anna University CES Project Associate - II posts?
faq.answer: The application must be sent by post or handed in on or before 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for Anna University CES Project Associate - II?
faq.answer: A B.E or B.Tech. in Civil Engineering or the other listed B.E branches with an M.E or M.Tech in Environmental Engineering, Environmental Management, Energy & Environment or the other specialisations listed for each project.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of Project Associate - II at Anna University CES?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs.30,000/- per month on a consolidated basis for each post.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the Anna University CES Project Associate - II posts?
faq.answer: Send the application form with copies of academic and experience documents in a cover, by post or in person, to the Professor and Director, Centre for Environmental Studies, Anna University, Chennai 600 025.

faq.question: Q6. What should be written on the application cover?
faq.answer: The name of the project you are applying for must be written on the cover.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Anna University CES Project Associate - II?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview, and selection will be based on the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Anna University CES Project Associate - II job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely temporary, for six months, extendable based on performance up to the project period.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for appearing for the interview.
